basic_info.description: Welcome to Showplace Square Lofts, where dramatic design meets modern comfort in the heart of Potrero Hill. This top-floor 1-bedroom, 2-bathroom loft spans two levels and features soaring 20-foot ceilings, a large skylight, and expansive windows that fill the space with natural light.The open-concept main level includes a cozy gas fireplace and a spacious kitchen, ideal for both cooking and entertaining, complete with granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances. A full bathroom with a walk-in shower provides convenience for guests.  Upstairs, the primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a custom California Closet, full bathroom, and a steel catwalk overlooking the living area perfect for a home office, creative studio, or lounge. Additional highlights include air conditioning, in-unit washer/dryer, and two deeded parking spaces for rare convenience in the city. Residents also enjoy a shared outdoor patio for morning coffee or evening relaxation.  Located in the vibrant Potrero Hill/Design District, you're just steps from Whole Foods, dining, and cafe shops, with quick access to public transportation and freeways.This exceptional loft offers the ultimate San Francisco lifestyle. Don't miss this opportunity!
